stem: What can the reader conclude about Jason Taylor based on these sentences?

options.label: A
options.text: Taylor bases his marine art designs on the nearby reefs.

options.label: B
options.text: Taylor questions the ability of his creations to last underwater.

options.label: C
options.text: Taylor wants his art to affect and be affected by its environment.

options.label: D
options.text: Taylor thinks marine life creates better art than he can.

visual_elements: "If people instead swim around the beautiful sculpture parks," Jason explains, "it will give the reefs a rest." (paragraph 5)
"Marine growth is taking on the role of the artist as it changes the sculpture." (paragraph 10)
